name: Hwaseong Fortress
description: Hwaseong Fortress encircles the old centre of Suwon, about 30 km south of Seoul. King Jeongjo built it between 1794 and 1796 to honour his father, Crown Prince Sado, whose tomb he had moved here. Visitors can walk the nearly 6 km of stone walls, passing four grand gates, bastions and artillery towers, and see the king's temporary palace inside.
